name: Monomagia Cantabile
original_name: モノマギア・カンタービレ
source:
"That's the only magic left in this world."

The protagonist finds herself standing in a strange room. 

Outside is a town with unusual buildings that look like something out of a picture book. 

This is a world where everything is decided by playing the card game "Monomagia". 

In order to return to her own world, the protagonist sets off on a journey with her friends. 

This is a story about "bringing hope for the future".

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“这是这个世界上仅存的魔法了。”

主角发现自己站在一个陌生的房间里。

外面是一座小镇，有着奇特的建筑，看起来就像是图画书中的东西。

这是一个一切都由卡牌游戏“Monomagia”决定的世界。

为了回到自己的世界，主角和朋友们一起踏上了旅程。

这是一个关于“为未来带来希望”的故事。

[改编自[url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]官方网站[/url]]
